names.title: Meter names
names.description: Optionally set custom names (used for device and entity names). By default the meter number (or the portal name) is used.

storage.title: Energy storage (net metering)
storage.description: Share of exported energy returned from the operator storage: 80 % (installations up to 10 kW) or 70 % (above 10 kW). It can be changed later in the options.

reauth_confirm.title: Re-authentication
reauth_confirm.description: The portal rejected the saved password for {username}. Enter the current password.

error.no_meters: No meters found on the account

init.title: Meters
init.description: Change custom meter names and the energy storage return ratio (80 % up to 10 kW, 70 % above). The integration reloads after saving.
